mounts.description: List of mount configurations for afuse; each entry defines a mount point and associated options. The mount_template and unmount_template directives are REQUIRED for each entry (per documentation). All fuse options are passed directly to FUSE via -o flags. %r and %m are reserved placeholders in templates for root directory and mount target respectively (expanded by afuse).
